summary: The prepared source already includes upstream PR 27998's issue-specific None-to-slot-0 guard. Added a direct regression that reproduces the reported TypeError when that guard is temporarily reverted and passes on the prepared implementation, including independent mixed and explicit-position boundaries.

Passing-after regression and independent boundaries: all-None defaults to slot 0, mixed None/valid positions preserve valid indices, and explicit track_positions remain authoritative; 3 passed. Raw output: reports/j-05a6a0f9f374/raw/passing_after.log
